# JobberRecruit — Full Platform Documentation & Entity Index

## Overview
JobberRecruit (https://jobberrecruit.com) is Nigeria's trusted recruitment platform and digital career hub. It provides job discovery, AI-driven candidate preparation, online skill training, instant certification, and direct employer hiring.

## Detailed Services & Features

### 1. Job Search & Matching
- Search jobs by Keyword, Industry Category, State/Location, and Work Arrangement (On-site, Hybrid, Remote).
- Daily job alerts via Email and Telegram.
- Direct quick-apply system with pre-filled profiles and resume attachments.

### 2. AI-Powered Career Tools
- **AI Resume Builder**: Generates ATS-friendly resume templates tailored to Nigerian and multinational employers.
- **AI Mock Interview Engine**: Simulates realistic interview scenarios with voice/text feedback and scoring.
- **CV Revamp Service**: Professional resume review by certified HR specialists.

### 3. E-Learning & Professional Certification
- Skill-building courses across Data Analytics (Excel & Python), Digital Marketing, Project Management, and Cybersecurity.
- Employer-verifiable digital certificates with unique verification codes.
- Live webinars and interactive masterclasses hosted by industry professionals.

### 4. Employer & Recruitment Solutions
- **Free Job Posting**: First job post is 100% free for verified businesses in Nigeria.
- **Pre-Screened Candidate Database**: Search candidate profiles filtered by qualifications, experience, and location.
- **Smart Employer Dashboard**: Track applications, schedule interviews, and manage hiring workflows.

- Lagos State (Yaba, Victoria Island, Ikeja, Lekki)
- Federal Capital Territory (Abuja)
- Rivers State (Port Harcourt)
- Oyo State (Ibadan)
- All 36 States in Nigeria + Remote Opportunities across Africa.
